_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 5% base rate for meaningful score moves in 12h windows and conflicting money-flow signals make HOLD the skilled graded call — there is no confirmed breaker visible to justify a directional claim.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward calls Disbelief with HOLD and medium conviction; narrative implies recovery but does not explicitly commit to a forward phase, creating a split on conviction and trajectory
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows spike above 30 + stablecoin growth recovers above 45 + BTC momentum holds above 50
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay below 10 + funding drops below 35 + BTC momentum breaks below 40
